name: cli-workbench
description: Claude Code mods for the cli-workbench terminal setup.

plugins.name: chezmoi-guard
plugins.description: Blocks edits to chezmoi-deployed files and shows when the source and the deployed files differ.

plugins.name: reply-polish
plugins.description: Lays out assistant replies for the terminal: a centered text column, headings, lists, tables and line breaks.

plugins.name: agent-state
plugins.description: Records whether each tmux pane's agent is working, waiting for you or idle, for the overview popup.

plugins.name: md-open
plugins.description: /md lists the Markdown files this conversation mentioned and opens the one you pick, read-only, in Neovim in a tmux popup.
